audit_document.normalization: UTF-8 text, CRLF and CR normalized to LF only. Implementation and inherited evidence hashes remain raw-byte identities.

static_checks.method: Read original bytes; stdlib ast.parse/symtable, JSON and SHA-256 only. No project imports, function execution, fixtures or native calls.

findings.title: Reservierungsleser kollidiert mit gehaltenem Schreibhandle
findings.finding: Worker read_exact uses read_source with verification=False, sharing only reads, while supervisor retains a read/write reservation handle. The proposed second open conflicts with the existing writer under Windows sharing rules.
findings.impact: The intended worker path cannot reach record_worker through this reservation read if preceding prerequisites succeed.
findings.limit: Static deduction under documented Windows semantics, not an observed platform error or executed counterexample.
findings.required_binding: Private reservation read and retained owner lifetime must be compatible without weakening source identity or the existing backend.

findings.title: Vollstaendige numerische Budgetherleitung fehlt
findings.finding: Source-site coverage and exact arithmetic validate supplied rows, not the truth of iteration bounds, domain costs, sizing assumptions or an admitted host envelope. S2-FE explicitly contains no materialized numeric certificate.
findings.impact: No complete native/logical/validation/memory/bootstrap/cleanup budget can be accepted. The 75623 source bytes and 975 AST calls are not execution limits.
findings.limit: Independent static proof rows may be supplied; no universal automatic cost prover is required. No invented numeric certificate or execution used to fill the gap.
findings.required_binding: Complete source-located derivation with justified loop and branch multiplicities, native-cost units, one-byte framing overhead, bootstrap originals, concurrent copies, buffer bounds and host admission.

findings.title: Bootstrapbudget erst nach Einlesen und Dekodieren geprueft
findings.finding: The receiver accepts a positive uint64 length and reads/parses the full payload before loading the process plan and checking maximum_ipc_bytes. The sender also encodes the whole payload before its write-budget check.
findings.impact: Finite length alone is not a pre-allocation resource bound. Parent timeout does not cap memory already allocated or parsing work performed.
findings.limit: No oversized payload was built or sent. Normal parent-side byte controls are present but do not establish receiver predecode bounds.
findings.required_binding: Independently admitted bootstrap extent and phase budget before materialization, reading and parsing; include encoding/decoding copies and bounded parent observation.

findings.title: Kind-Einmalstart ohne gebundene aktuelle Ownerberechtigung
findings.finding: The outer observer checks the trusted admission context, but direct child entry validates persisted matching handoff bytes and actual parent PID only. A new ChildOwner starts with an empty attempted set and may spawn a supervisor after START.
findings.impact: Matching historical dispatch/seal bytes do not establish that this real parent currently owns the one-use invocation. Later output collisions do not prevent the earlier repeat process spawn.
findings.limit: Conditional static path assuming a future valid package and matching retained records. No current valid package, attack execution or successful recorder bypass is claimed.
findings.required_binding: Bind live admitted owner, child role, channel provenance and single-use authority before any child spawn or recorder-gate change.

findings.title: Runtime-, Import- und Layoutrollen nicht vollstaendig gebunden
findings.finding: Listed imports need only include the four infrastructure refs; transitive execution closure remains unproven. Interpreter FileRef is not relationally tied to declared SourceManifest runtime identity. layout_contract_file may be any historical ref. Child imports precede its SourceLease verification.
findings.impact: Raw hash consistency and nonempty reviewer text alone cannot accept executed source provenance, exact layout-document role or native parent admission.
findings.limit: Parent-held leases protect the regular path when complete and admitted. Missing external evidence is not replaced by this audit, and metadata was not recollected.
findings.required_binding: Exact layout-document role, interpreter/runtime relation, complete bootstrap closure and independently admitted provenance with explicit external trust root.

findings.title: Cleanupfehler und Abschlussherkunft nicht vollstaendig weitergebunden
findings.finding: The private supervisor wrapper discards abort() cleanup errors. The outer handler preserves StartError.status only, flattening other failure types to ABORTED_INCOMPLETE. Pre-dispatch validation failures outside the try block require independent caller handling.
findings.impact: Fail-closed rejection remains, but close/prerequisite causes and phase-correct terminal evidence are incomplete. Direct process observations must be distinguished from delegated pipe/control completion statements.
findings.limit: Real owned handle exit/identity checks are implemented. Existing supervisor control.finish() precedes success. No claim that those checks are absent or that a false successful run was observed.
findings.required_binding: Preserve phase, original cause and cleanup failure through terminal owner evidence; distinguish directly observed OS facts from source-bound delegated closures and the caller's observer-exit proof.

numeric_budget_certificate.warning: Fixed inventory is not a complete runtime, byte, memory, native-operation or deadline certificate.

positive_static_observations: Four private implementation files exactly match S2-FE; 15 inherited source/evidence bindings unchanged.
Closed forms, canonical digest comparisons, frozen package bytes and fixed separate dispatch/seal paths exist.
Normal observer path checks external grant and consumes invocation before durable dispatch; no automatic ledger provisioning or retry is implemented there.
Normal first spawn follows reserve_dispatch return; existing dispatch/seal files are not deleted.
Observer owns duplicated process handles and verifies real process identity/exit in code; receipt paths and original report/trace/control bytes are checked.
No public field or memory integration added by this audit; static syntax and symbol checks are not execution or functional acceptance.

Original inner execution/review bytes plus independent outer start admission.
Full noncircular start package and complete justified numeric budget certificate with admitted host envelope.
